## Why visit

A worthwhile extension to a Macclesfield visit for the local brewery connection and comfortable pub setting. The main bar has a substantial bank of pumps, while a smaller panelled room gives a quieter alternative. Its social programme, including films and science evenings, makes it more individual than a generic bar, but the everyday reason to go is Bollington cask in a relaxed local. Combine it with RedWillow and Waters Green if you have a full Macclesfield afternoon. Do not confuse its operating status with the separately closed Vale Inn in Bollington.
